<?php

class AsyncTaskQueue {
    private array $tasks = [];
    private array $results = [];
    
    public function enqueue(callable $task, string $id): void {
        $this->tasks[$id] = $task;
    }
    
    public function processAll(): array {
        foreach ($this->tasks as $id => $task) {
            $this->results[$id] = $task();
        }
        return $this->results;
    }
}

class URLNormalizer {
    private array $allowedSchemes = ['http', 'https'];
    private array $trustedDomains = ['search.internal.corp', 'index.internal.corp', 'cdn.internal.corp'];
    
    public function normalize(string $url): string {
        $url = trim($url);
        $url = str_replace('\\', '/', $url);
        // Decode any percent-encoded characters for normalization
        $decoded = rawurldecode($url);
        return $decoded;
    }
    
    public function isTrusted(string $url): bool {
        $normalized = $this->normalize($url);
        $parsed = parse_url($normalized);
        
        if ($parsed === false || !isset($parsed['host'])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if (!in_array(strtolower($parsed['scheme'] ?? ''), $this->allowedSchemes)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $host = strtolower($parsed['host']);
        foreach ($this->trustedDomains as $trusted) {
            if ($this->hostMatches($host, $trusted)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private function hostMatches(string $host, string $trusted): bool {
        // Check if host ends with trusted domain (allows subdomains)
        if ($host === $trusted) return true;
        if (str_ends_with($host, '.' . $trusted)) return true;
        return false;
    }
}

class SearchIndexService {
    private AsyncTaskQueue $queue;
    private URLNormalizer $normalizer;
    private array $indexedPages = [];
    private string $callbackRegistry = '';
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->queue = new AsyncTaskQueue();
        $this->normalizer = new URLNormalizer();
    }
    
    public function handleIndexRequest(array $request): array {
        $action = $request['action'] ?? 'index';
        
        switch ($action) {
            case 'index':
                return $this->indexPage($request);
            case 'search':
                return $this->search($request);
            case 'callback':
                return $this->handleCallback($request);
            default:
                return ['error' => 'Unknown action'];
        }
    }
    
    private function indexPage(array $request): array {
        $url = $request['url'] ?? '';
        $content = $request['content'] ?? '';
        
        if (empty($url) || empty($content)) {
            return ['error' => 'URL and content required'];
        }
        
        $taskId = hash('sha256', $url);
        $this->queue->enqueue(function() use ($url, $content, $taskId) {
            $this->indexedPages[$taskId] = [
                'url' => $url,
                'content' => $content,
                'indexed_at' => time()
            ];
            return true;
        }, $taskId);
        
        $this->queue->processAll();
        return ['status' => 'indexed', 'id' => $taskId];
    }
    
    private function search(array $request): array {
        $query = $request['query'] ?? '';
        $results = [];
        
        foreach ($this->indexedPages as $id => $page) {
            if (stripos($page['content'], $query) !== false) {
                $results[] = ['id' => $id, 'url' => $page['url']];
            }
        }
        
        return ['results' => $results];
    }
    
    private function handleCallback(array $request): array {
        $callbackUrl = $request['callback_url'] ?? '';
        $token = $request['verification_token'] ?? '';
        
        if (empty($callbackUrl) || empty($token)) {
            return ['error' => 'Callback URL and token required'];
        }
        
        // Validate token format
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/', $token)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid token format'];
        }
        
        // Build the redirect target with verification
        $redirectTarget = $this->buildVerifiedRedirect($callbackUrl, $token);
        
        if ($redirectTarget === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Untrusted callback destination'];
        }
        
        return ['redirect' => $redirectTarget];
    }
    
    private function buildVerifiedRedirect(string $url, string $token): ?string {
        // First pass: check if URL is trusted
        if (!$this->normalizer->isTrusted($url)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Build final URL with token parameter
        $separator = (strpos($url, '?') !== false) ? '&' : '?';
        $finalUrl = $url . $separator . 'token=' . $token;
        
        // Second pass validation on the ORIGINAL url (not finalUrl)
        // This is intentional - we already validated the base
        $recheck = $this->performAsyncValidation($url);
        
        if (!$recheck) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $finalUrl;
    }
    
    private function performAsyncValidation(string $url): bool {
        $isValid = false;
        
        $this->queue->enqueue(function() use ($url, &$isValid) {
            // Simulate async DNS resolution and validation
            $normalized = $this->normalizer->normalize($url);
            $parsed = parse_url($normalized);
            
            if ($parsed && isset($parsed['host'])) {
                // Verify the host resolves and matches expectations
                // In the async context, we re-normalize which applies rawurldecode
                $host = $parsed['host'];
                $isValid = !empty($host) && strlen($host) < 255;
            }
            return $isValid;
        }, 'validation_' . md5($url));
        
        $this->queue->processAll();
        return $isValid;
    }
}

// Request handler
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    if (!is_array($input)) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid JSON']);
        exit;
    }
    
    $service = new SearchIndexService();
    $response = $service->handleIndexRequest($input);
    
    if (isset($response['redirect'])) {
        header('Location: ' . $response['redirect']);
        exit;
    }
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($response);
}
